caseName: Christianson v. Colt Industries Operating Corp.
caseNameFull: Christianson v. Colt Industries Operating Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Certiorari granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. In addition to this question, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: “Did the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit have jurisdiction of the appeal from the District Court judgment entered on July 19, 1985?”
